quote: Yeah. We're just calling we saw we met with you a while back about solar.
stewart_read: Rep references a prior meeting as the only legitimacy anchor but never states company identity clearly or confirms lead source beyond 'Ion' mentioned much later at 01:57.
coaching_implication: State company name and lead context up front, not buried mid-call in the text-confirmation line.

stewart_read: This is a soft deferral objection the rep never directly names or resolves; it gets bypassed via a time-commitment reframe rather than addressed.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic read: rep may have sensed pushing on 'why not now' would lose the customer, and pivoting to low-commitment framing was the faster path to a yes — this is supported by the customer immediately offering availability afterward.
coaching_implication: Even if the pivot worked, rep should verbally acknowledge the deferral ('totally get it, no pressure') before reframing, per protocols.hello_objection_not_interested — right now it reads as talked-over.

quote: And then I think there were before, there was issues with credit. Is your credit score above 670 now?
stewart_read: Rep surfaces a real prior disqualifier but gets an inconclusive answer and does not resolve it before locking a date/time.
coaching_implication: Should have gotten a firmer commitment ('can you check today and text me before Monday?') rather than proceeding to book on an unresolved gate.

quote: if the credit is good, can we do Monday morning or afternoon?
stewart_read: Appointment is explicitly conditioned on an unverified credit qualifier, making this a fragile, conditional set rather than a clean book.
coaching_implication: Flag conditional bookings like this so the closer knows credit is unresolved and expects possible DQ on arrival.

quote: On Monday, I'm gonna be at home. I've been sorry. I've been busy really, really bad. But Monday, I'm off.
stewart_read: Customer hands the rep an easy opening (being busy, being off Monday) but rep doesn't use it to build any curiosity about why solar matters to them — just grabs the day and moves to scheduling logistics.
coaching_implication: Even a single line like 'what got you looking into solar in the first place?' would have created the interest anchor that was otherwise entirely skipped.

quote: the text is gonna say, hey. This is Carter with Ion. If you could just let me know if that'll work.
stewart_read: No explicit 'is that fair?' handshake or day/time recap with the no-driving/computer instruction — button-up is thin, leaning on a follow-up text to do the confirming work.
coaching_implication: Recap day, time, and format verbally before ending the call; don't outsource the confirmation entirely to a text the customer may not read carefully.
